headline: SPACE INVADERS rebuilt: the arcade now actually ends
lede: Batch 13 turned up worse than a missing seed — the Feb-2026 Space Invaders port had no terminal at all: hits, landings and cleared waves silently reset and the score never moved. The rules were rebuilt faithful to the 1978 machine, then pinned to a seed and wired into the harness.

notes.text: Faithful terminal model: 30/20/20/10 row bands, mystery UFO worth 50–300, three lives with respawn grace, landing ends the run, waves speed up and start lower. Score header, spare-cannon row and the accelerating descending-four march added in the overlay palette.

?seed=N replays the exact world: the sim was extracted to pure sim.js with zero Math.random, every roll drawn from the seeded stream. invaderscheck proves boot, rules, winnability and determinism (34 checks), with two mutants shown to break it — including one surviving the first attempt, which is exactly what mutants are for.

Two lanes collided on this batch: the warden idle-kicked slot b while it was building live (claim-based idle detection can't see unclaimed work), a rescue session resumed b's pushed branch as a false corpse and merged it — game shipped verified twice, zero rework, story in the issue. Slot-b's feed question refiled as #1492 after its predecessor auto-closed on a parsing false-positive.

Pin floor now 44 titles reporting+pinned (feedbackcheck 223 laws green). Batch-14 map audited: Pacman, Frogger, Adventure, MissileCommand are mechanical seedpins; Pong, Asteroids, Centipede, Defender need terminal restoration first — reporting them today would fake 'done'.
